decision: Yield one microtask before terminating an OCR worker during disposal.
reason: Independent browser consumer exposed immediate-cancel race: pinned Tesseract 7 awaits data-URL decoding before dispatch, so synchronous termination nulled its worker before postMessage.
validation: Added dispatch-order regression; cancellation still rejects promptly without waiting for recognition. 22 unit tests pass; browser consumer verifies actual engine cancellation.
